name: Default
shortDescription: Mainsail web interface for Klipper 3D printers, connecting from the browser to one or more Moonraker instances you add in the UI.

alerts.message: This deploys only the web interface; your browser connects directly to each printer's Moonraker API. Because the page is served over HTTPS, Moonraker must be reachable from your browser over a secure WebSocket (wss), its cors_domains setting must include this domain, and your browser must be allowed by trusted_clients or a Moonraker login.
